notes:
Account briefing:
- Account: Orchard Quant Reserve — proprietary trading division (global, ~1.2k employees). Heavy emphasis on deterministic latency and predictable throughput for trading signals and execution assistant.
- Primary ask: Dedicated GPU pool with contractual throughput & latency guarantees; explicit SLA credit schedule.
Key technical requirements:
- Throughput: baseline batch embeddings 100k requests/day, embeddings throughput target ~50k/hr during market open.
- Reserved capacity: baseline 8 A100-equivalent GPUs; burst to 12 during market opens (automated burst policy required).
- Latency SLOs: p50 < 10ms, p95 < 30ms for small chat/rerank invocations (<=512 tokens). For long-form generation acceptable p50 < 60ms.
- Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to quantized model variants when capacity constrained; graceful degradation required. Cross-region DR to EU for failover.
SLA negotiation points (legal/procurement):
- Uptime target requested: 99.95% monthly for Dedicated pool.
- Credit schedule proposed by customer: 20% credit if uptime in 99.9-99.95, 50% if uptime 99.5-99.9, full monthly fee refund if <99.5. Wants explicit measurement method (exclude scheduled maintenance, customer-caused issues).
- Maintenance windows: allow one 2-hour weekly window between 02:00-06:00 ET; require >=14 days notice for planned maintenance. Avoid maintenance during market opens.
- Support response times: P1 response <=30 minutes, mitigation plan within 2 hours; P2 response <=2 hours, mitigation within 8 hours. 24/7 on-call during market hours (04:00-20:00 ET). Request dedicated TAM and escalation path.
Security/compliance:
- SOC2 is a gating item for sign-off (customer requested recent report). Need KMS/HSM integration details and key rotation policy. Data residency controls: primary in us-east-1, backups in us-west-2; EU DR region required.

- 2026-02-18: dedicated pool demo (internal perf baseline).
- 2026-02-25: security review kickoff (requested SOC2 & KMS docs).
- 2026-03-02: POC week 1 telemetry: p50=9ms, p95=28ms on 8-GPU pool (meets SLO targets in controlled tests).
- 2026-03-08: pricing & SLA review call (Fireflies ff_842309).
